name: SWEEP-S10v1 Essence famine
_design: New idea from S4/S5 (monitor 3). In several runs an agent attacked and killed the fruit tree it lived on to absorb essence from the residue (S5v2 a07 r17, the tree it shared with its poor roommate; S4v2 a06 r21; also S6v1 a03, S3v1 a04), destroying its own food for about 1 essence. Here that choice is the whole question and its consequence is clean: 8 identical agents, each alone on its own mature fruit tree on a 13x13 map with no terrain (S1 ring: Manhattan 4-6 between neighbours, 2 more trees at seeded random points). Every agent starts with 0 essence, so every upgrade is out of reach; essence comes only from residue (a killed plant leaves 50% of its essence, a dead agent 40% of its own, which is 0 here) and transfers. Essence absorption is 0.5 for all (shipped 0.1), so a tree killed around r20 (about 25 essence) yields about 6 essence: two upgrades. Trees fruit every 3 rounds (inflow 20), about 5 net compute per round, roughly what an agent thinking every round spends (4.3 thought + 1 upkeep): a keeper who waits between fruits lives, an agent that kills its tree loses its income and should starve within about 20 rounds. Nobody is told any of this beyond the rules. 120 compute, absorption 0.3, vision 2, comm 3, residue 100%, interrupts on damage and message, input cap 10000, 60 rounds, seed 1010.
